title: Conditional return matrix
brief: Produce the same matrix through conditional aggregation.
instructions: Return the same observed UTC 2024 refund-month quantity matrix as the pivot report. Sum refunded quantities by reason, filling absent reasons with zero. Equivalent PIVOT results also qualify.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes return_id,reason,qty,refunded_at,status from returns without solving conditional return matrix.

hints.text: Conditional aggregates form fixed columns without changing the grouping grain.
Group refund events by typed UTC month and sum each reason through CASE.
Count quantities rather than return rows, and exclude rejected returns.
